# Modern Web Guidance

Skills that teach agents to work with Modern Web Guidance. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance), at commit `b31dc0a`.

Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Modern Web Guidance**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Modern Web Guidance**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install modern-web-guidance@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `chrome-extensions`, `modern-web-guidance`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

Two guides show `navigator.sendBeacon()` in sample code for batching analytics events. That is guide content, not something this plugin sends.
